verdict.rationale: Datadog has a first-party docs page for Bits AI, a built-in AI assistant, so an in-product assistant exists. The pack includes only the page title, though, with no detail on what tasks it can take on or how delegation works. Missing for 10: documented task-delegation capabilities (e.g., investigating incidents, running queries, taking actions), detail on the scope of agentic actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
